package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion   = "lesson-message-context.v1"
	LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 = "lesson-message-context.v2"
	MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes      = 12000
	MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes     = 1000
	MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes   = 4000
)

var (
	ErrInvalidLessonContext     = errors.New("invalid lesson context")
	ErrLessonContextNotFound    = errors.New("lesson context not found")
	ErrLessonContextUnavailable = errors.New("lesson context unavailable")
)

type LessonMessageMode string

const (
	LessonMessageModeOverview  LessonMessageMode = "lesson_overview"
	LessonMessageModeSelection LessonMessageMode = "selection"
)

type LessonMessageContext struct {
	Schema             string            `json:"schema,omitempty"`
	Mode               LessonMessageMode `json:"mode,omitempty"`
	CourseID           string            `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID           string            `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	ContentRevision    string            `json:"content_revision"`
	SelectedText       string            `json:"selected_text,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID     string            `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string            `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	ContentDigest      string            `json:"content_digest,omitempty"`
}

// UnmarshalJSON keeps v2 exact and rejects cross-schema anchors rather than
// silently dropping them into the legacy mutable lane.
func (input *LessonMessageContext) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	type plain LessonMessageContext
	var value plain
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&value); err != nil {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := decodeLessonContextFields(data, &fields); err != nil || fields == nil {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	if value.Schema == LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
		expectedFields := 8
		if value.Mode == LessonMessageModeSelection {
			expectedFields = 9
		}
		if len(fields) != expectedFields || !utf8.Valid(data) {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		required := []string{"schema", "mode", "course_id", "lesson_id", "content_revision", "learning_path_id", "learning_path_item_id", "content_digest"}
		for _, field := range required {
			raw, ok := fields[field]
			if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
				return ErrInvalidLessonContext
			}
		}
		_, selectionPresent := fields["selected_text"]
		if (value.Mode == LessonMessageModeSelection) != selectionPresent {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	} else {
		for field := range fields {
			switch strings.ToLower(field) {
			case "learning_path_id", "learning_path_item_id", "content_digest":
				return ErrInvalidLessonContext
			}
		}
	}
	*input = LessonMessageContext(value)
	return nil
}

func decodeLessonContextFields(data []byte, fields *map[string]json.RawMessage) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	result := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for decoder.More() {
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		name, ok := token.(string)
		if !ok {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		if _, present := result[name]; present {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		var raw json.RawMessage
		if err := decoder.Decode(&raw); err != nil {
			return ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		result[name] = raw
	}
	if _, err := decoder.Token(); err != nil {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	*fields = result
	return nil
}

func NormalizeLessonMessageContext(input *LessonMessageContext) (*LessonMessageContext, error) {
	if input == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if input.Schema == LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
		if !validAssignedUUID(input.CourseID) || !validAssignedUUID(input.LessonID) || !validAssignedUUID(input.ContentRevision) ||
			!validAssignedUUID(input.LearningPathID) || !validAssignedUUID(input.LearningPathItemID) || !validAssignedContentDigest(input.ContentDigest) || !utf8.ValidString(input.SelectedText) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		switch input.Mode {
		case LessonMessageModeOverview:
			if input.SelectedText != "" {
				return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
			}
		case LessonMessageModeSelection:
			if strings.TrimSpace(input.SelectedText) == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.SelectedText) > MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes {
				return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
			}
		default:
			return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		copy := *input
		return &copy, nil
	}
	if input.LearningPathID != "" || input.LearningPathItemID != "" || input.ContentDigest != "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.Mode = LessonMessageMode(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.Mode))))
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LessonID)
	revision, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, strings.TrimSpace(input.ContentRevision))
	if err != nil || revision.IsZero() || !utf8.ValidString(input.SelectedText) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	// Persisted pre-v1 selections remain valid as non-source history. New source
	// messages are separately required to use the explicit current schema.
	legacy := input.Schema == "" && input.Mode == "" && input.CourseID == "" && input.LessonID == ""
	if legacy {
		if strings.TrimSpace(input.SelectedText) == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(input.SelectedText) > MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes {
			return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		return &LessonMessageContext{
			ContentRevision: revision.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), SelectedText: input.SelectedText,
		}, nil
	}
	if input.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion || !validUUID(input.CourseID) || !validUUID(input.LessonID) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	switch input.Mode {
	case LessonMessageModeOverview:
		if input.SelectedText != "" {
			return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	case LessonMessageModeSelection:
		if strings.TrimSpace(input.SelectedText) == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(input.SelectedText) > MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes {
			return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	default:
		return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return &LessonMessageContext{
		Schema: input.Schema, Mode: input.Mode, CourseID: input.CourseID, LessonID: input.LessonID,
		ContentRevision: revision.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), SelectedText: input.SelectedText,
	}, nil
}

func NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(input *LessonMessageContext) (*LessonMessageContext, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeLessonMessageContext(input)
	if err != nil || normalized == nil || (normalized.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion && normalized.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return normalized, nil
}

// CourseLessonContent is transient canonical Course data used only to verify a
// source anchor. Full content must never be copied into model variables.
type CourseLessonContent struct {
	LessonID        string
	CourseID        string
	SectionID       string
	Language        string
	Title           string
	Excerpt         string
	Description     string
	ContentRevision string
}

// LessonTeachingContext is the minimal verified fragment supplied to policy
// and model orchestration.
type LessonTeachingContext struct {
	Schema             string            `json:"schema"`
	Mode               LessonMessageMode `json:"mode"`
	CourseID           string            `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID           string            `json:"lesson_id"`
	SectionID          string            `json:"section_id,omitempty"`
	Language           string            `json:"language"`
	ContentRevision    string            `json:"content_revision"`
	Title              string            `json:"title,omitempty"`
	Excerpt            string            `json:"excerpt,omitempty"`
	SelectedText       string            `json:"selected_text,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID     string            `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string            `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	ContentDigest      string            `json:"content_digest,omitempty"`
}

func VerifyLessonContext(
	lessonID string,
	source *LessonMessageContext,
	content CourseLessonContent,
) (LessonTeachingContext, error) {
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	content.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(content.LessonID)
	content.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(content.CourseID)
	content.SectionID = strings.TrimSpace(content.SectionID)
	content.Language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(content.Language))
	content.ContentRevision = strings.TrimSpace(content.ContentRevision)
	normalizedSource, err := NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(source)
	if err != nil || normalizedSource.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion || !validUUID(lessonID) || content.LessonID != lessonID ||
		normalizedSource.LessonID != lessonID || !validUUID(content.CourseID) ||
		content.CourseID != normalizedSource.CourseID ||
		(content.SectionID != "" && !validUUID(content.SectionID)) || !validValue(content.Language, 35) ||
		normalizedSource.ContentRevision != content.ContentRevision || !utf8.ValidString(content.Title) ||
		!utf8.ValidString(content.Excerpt) || !utf8.ValidString(content.Description) {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	verified := LessonTeachingContext{
		Schema: LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: normalizedSource.Mode,
		CourseID: normalizedSource.CourseID, LessonID: lessonID, SectionID: content.SectionID,
		Language: content.Language, ContentRevision: content.ContentRevision,
	}
	switch normalizedSource.Mode {
	case LessonMessageModeOverview:
		verified.Title = strings.TrimSpace(content.Title)
		verified.Excerpt = strings.TrimSpace(content.Excerpt)
		if verified.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(verified.Title) > MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(verified.Excerpt) > MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	case LessonMessageModeSelection:
		if !strings.Contains(content.Title, normalizedSource.SelectedText) &&
			!strings.Contains(content.Excerpt, normalizedSource.SelectedText) &&
			!strings.Contains(content.Description, normalizedSource.SelectedText) {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		verified.SelectedText = normalizedSource.SelectedText
	default:
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return NormalizeLessonTeachingContext(verified)
}

func NormalizeLessonTeachingContext(input LessonTeachingContext) (LessonTeachingContext, error) {
	if input.Schema == LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
		source, err := NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(&LessonMessageContext{Schema: input.Schema, Mode: input.Mode, CourseID: input.CourseID, LessonID: input.LessonID, ContentRevision: input.ContentRevision, SelectedText: input.SelectedText, LearningPathID: input.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: input.LearningPathItemID, ContentDigest: input.ContentDigest})
		if err != nil || source == nil || input.SectionID != "" || input.Language != "" || !utf8.ValidString(input.Title) || !utf8.ValidString(input.Excerpt) {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		if input.Mode == LessonMessageModeOverview {
			if utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Title) > MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Excerpt) > MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes {
				return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
			}
		} else if input.Title != "" || input.Excerpt != "" {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		return input, nil
	}
	if input.LearningPathID != "" || input.LearningPathItemID != "" || input.ContentDigest != "" {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.Mode = LessonMessageMode(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.Mode))))
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LessonID)
	input.SectionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SectionID)
	input.Language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Language))
	input.ContentRevision = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContentRevision)
	input.Title = strings.TrimSpace(input.Title)
	input.Excerpt = strings.TrimSpace(input.Excerpt)
	if input.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion || !validUUID(input.CourseID) || !validUUID(input.LessonID) ||
		(input.SectionID != "" && !validUUID(input.SectionID)) || !validValue(input.Language, 35) ||
		!utf8.ValidString(input.Title) || !utf8.ValidString(input.Excerpt) || !utf8.ValidString(input.SelectedText) {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	revision, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, input.ContentRevision)
	if err != nil || revision.IsZero() {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	input.ContentRevision = revision.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	switch input.Mode {
	case LessonMessageModeOverview:
		if input.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Title) > MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Excerpt) > MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes || input.SelectedText != "" {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	case LessonMessageModeSelection:
		if input.Title != "" || input.Excerpt != "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.SelectedText) == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(input.SelectedText) > MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	default:
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return input, nil
}

func VerifyLessonSelection(
	lessonID string,
	source *LessonMessageContext,
	content CourseLessonContent,
) (LessonTeachingContext, error) {
	verified, err := VerifyLessonContext(lessonID, source, content)
	if err != nil || verified.Mode != LessonMessageModeSelection {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return verified, nil
}
